job.name: s6_first
job.prompt: Semi-flat illustration, medium close shot. The pharmacist from the photo reference (same face, hair, white coat) behind a pharmacy counter on the right, has just looked up and is greeting a customer who is just stepping up to the counter on the left (customer seen from the side, clearly visible, mouth closed — has not started talking yet). Their eyes meet, the pharmacist smiles warmly and speaks first. Both people large in frame. Walls and shelves have NO signs, posters, labels or text at all.
job.meaning: фармацевт первой поднимает взгляд и здоровается, раньше чем посетитель начал говорить
